hooks.command: bash -c 'file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.cts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error" | head -20 || echo "typecheck ok";; *) exit 0;; esac'
hooks.description: Run tsc --noEmit after any TS/TSX edit; report errors to Claude.
